verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents alerting on logs (patterns, counts, attribute values) and creating alerts seeded from any dashboard panel, which implies alerts on metrics and traces too. Alerts are also covered in its Datadog migration guide and its AI/MCP tooling. The pack has no evidence of the notification-management half of the story: routing, grouping and silencing. Missing for 10: notification routing to channels/teams, alert grouping, silencing/muting, explicit docs for alerting on metrics and traces, independent hands-on corroboration.
